I'm settling on the program: the user wants their own agent, so I'll use the coding agent's Program.cs as the listing. It names CodingCatalog from the demo, and I should be upfront that they'd need to name their own catalogue to start their own program. The docs disagree a bit on whether the program names packs, so I'll give the full program as it appears on the page and note that.

I'm settling how to present the program: I'll give the coding agent's Program.cs, noting that CodingCatalog is the demo's and would be replaced by their own catalogue, and that the settings go in a separate block.
